releases.notes:
## Version 1.16.3

This release mainly focuses on stabilizing refilling again, so if you previously encountered issues with refilling broken tools, refilling to the offhand or refilling triggering when it shouldn't (on block pick or other interactions) - these should all be fixed now.

It also contains an update of the Tweed config library so this release is compatible with the Spice Of Fabric beta versions.

Also Minecraft 26.2 support :)

releases.notes:
## Version 1.16.0

- I realized that I was blind all along and overcomplicated the whole
  refilling thing:
  - the companion mod is no more, we're back to working with Vanilla
    servers out-of-the-box
  - the refilling/tool picking system is rebuilt from the ground up,
    enabling the following benefits
- Mouse Wheelie will now refill/tool-pick from bundles.
- Mouse Wheelie now extends the Vanilla pick block functionality to pick
  from bundles.
- Both of these can be disabled in the config.
- "Restore selected slot" in the Refilling settings has been renamed to
  "Always keep selected slot". It should achieve the same thing as
  before but with less hassle in the background.
- You can now enable "Always keep selected slot" for tool picking as
  well.
- Updated to the new Amecs modules. If you installed Amecs alongside
  you'll need to update that too to 1.6.0 or later.

Release by Siphalor
